sourceText:
Whampers
By: Bleujeen
Published: Sunday, March 28, 2010 - 8:17am

Ingredients




6 English muffins, halved
8 ounces cheddar cheese, grated
1/2 stick butter, softened
1 can fancy lump crabmeat, drained
Paprika

Preparation

1 Toast the English muffin halves until slightly browned. 2 Blend the cheese, butter, and crabmeat. 3 Place  the toasted muffins on a cookie sheet. 4 Spread the crabmeat mixture on the toasted muffins. 5 Sprinkle with paprika. 6 Bake at 375 degrees until bubbly.

About


This is an old family favorite for at least 2 generations, and we're trying to convert the young ones.
